configuration.authDetails: Adobe IMS OAuth server-to-server (client_credentials). Custom refreshAccessToken: POST https://ims-na1.adobelogin.com/ims/token/v3 (form-encoded client_id, client_secret, grant_type=client_credentials, scope; scope open, Q10). Token ~24h. extendRequest adds Authorization: Bearer and x-api-key. Bearer only required for inlets with authentication enabled. testAuthentication fetches a token only (org, sandbox and inlet are action fields).

settings.name: clientId
settings.description: Adobe IMS OAuth server-to-server Client ID ("API key (Client ID)" in Developer Console); sent as x-api-key and in the token request. May become optional for unauthenticated inlets (Q10).

settings.name: clientSecret
settings.description: Adobe IMS OAuth server-to-server Client Secret; used only in the token request. May become optional for unauthenticated inlets (Q10).

apiOverview.authScheme: Bearer token (Adobe IMS OAuth server-to-server); only required for authenticated inlets

mappings.actionDescription: Send Segment Track, Page and Screen events to an AEP streaming inlet as XDM ExperienceEvents.
considerations: Schema prerequisites (Q18): ExperienceEvent class and Identity Map field group; Adobe Analytics ExperienceEvent Full Extension field group if eVar/prop paths are mapped.
perform also posts a one-message array to the batch endpoint so both paths share 207 parsing; sendMessage is a fallback only.
performBatch must return a MultiStatusResponse, or Adobe's per-message failures are treated as success.
schemaRef must be identical in header and body.xdmMeta and match the dataset's schema.

Identity rules (Q5): drop blank identities; exactly one primary (flagged custom, else PID, else first custom, else ECID); an event with no identity is rejected locally with 400 PAYLOAD_VALIDATION_FAILED and not sent.
Map Adobe 403 to 401 so core's token refresh fires.
xdmMapping keys are customer-entered dotted paths expanded with setPath; reject __proto__, constructor and prototype; explicit collision rule.

Lift-and-shift paths (_experience.analytics.customDimensions.eVars.eVarN, props.propN, event1to100.eventN.value) map through xdmMapping; arrays (lists, listProps, productListItems) need code; stringify policy is Q19; automatic toggle is Q16.
Batching: batch_size default 100 (10-250), hidden batch_bytes 800000 under the 1 MB 413 limit, hidden batch_keys imsOrgId/sandboxName/inletId.
x-api-key header is not in the ingestion spec (Q10); flowId required in spec but omitted in Adobe's tutorial (Q15).
Late/future timestamps: no blocking in the destination (Q8); Adobe's class says timestamp must be in the past.

singleEndpoint.notes: Same message format, 200 StreamingIngestionResponse. Fallback only; perform uses the batch endpoint with one message.

batchEndpoint.notes: Preferred delivery path; backs performBatch. No documented count limit; 1 MB per request (413). Adobe's tutorial example bundles 200 x 1 KB messages. Returns 207 with responses[] index-matched to messages[].

responseHandling.details: 207 BatchResponseDTO: responses[i] index-matched to messages[i]; xactionId = success (setSuccessResponseAtIndex). Failed entries carry statusCode and message per Adobe's tutorial (not in spec's BatchResponseMessage; verify live). 400 not retried; 401 refresh+retry; 403 reported as 401; 413 not retried; 429/500/503 retried. Request-level non-207 fails every message with that status. Local Q5 rejection: setErrorResponseAtIndex 400 PAYLOAD_VALIDATION_FAILED, not sent; no HTTP call if all rejected. Single message over 1 MB: 413 at its index.

mappings.actionDescription: Send Segment Identify traits to an AEP Profile dataset as XDM Individual Profile records, for a CJA query-time join with the event dataset.
considerations: P0 in the PRD but conditional: only if JPMC picks the CJA query-time join (Q2).
Same endpoint and envelope as sendEvent (Q4) with an Individual Profile schema and a Profile- and Identity-enabled dataset; possibly a separate inlet.
Must send the same primary identity as sendEvent (e.g. PID from userId) or CJA's Person ID join returns nothing.
_id and timestamp are not sent (record class). Required fields of the Individual Profile class are not stated by Adobe; confirm live.
Same Q5 identity rules; Profile requires a primary identity.
Reuses envelope, identity, setPath and 207 handling from sendEvent; same batching fields and batch keys.
sourceName is not in the refined-actions field list for this action; header.source.name omitted (Adobe fills it).

batchEndpoint.notes: Preferred delivery path; backs performBatch. 1 MB per request; no documented count limit.

fieldMappings.transformDetail: Individual Profile schema; also written to body.xdmMeta.schemaRef.id
Q5 rules; must match sendEvent's PID for the CJA join
setPath with the same guards; Individual Profile paths

responseHandling.details: Same as sendEvent: index-matched 207 entries, 403 reported as 401, 429/500/503 retried, 400/413 not; local Q5 rejection; MultiStatusResponse.

openItems.notes: statusCode/message on failed responses[] entries are from Adobe's tutorial, not the spec; capture a live 207.
Spec requires it; tutorial omits it (Q15).
Only 1 MB documented in spec; 1,000 requests/sec and 10,000 messages/sec from the streaming overview page (Q14).
Paths work via xdmMapping; automatic toggle needs a property-to-eVar table of unknown source (Q16); arrays need code; stringify policy Q19.
Not stated on Adobe's class page; confirm live.
